label: PF Backlog 590
title: Project-size profile lever: small/medium/large selects required vs optional sections + counts bands + size budget
body:
## Problem / why
config/artifact-contracts/profiles.json exponents only size_multiplier (target/max lines) and is never read during generation. There is no lever to make a simple project lighter and a large one fuller.
## Goal & value
One lever scales depth: small -> required sections only, low counts, small budgets; medium -> recommended; large -> optional sections + higher counts/budgets.
## Acceptance criteria
- resolve()/generation_plan() accept the project profile (from project.json/config) and select required vs optional sections + counts bands + size.
- The profile is read from the project and passed through generation (not defaulted to medium).
## Approach
Extend profiles.json with section/count policy; plumb profile into core/contracts.resolve + stage_runner/agent_runner.
